column1: # Curated drug-name aliases for F6b (src/ksp/features/phospho_inhib.py). Hand-curated by feat-phospho, 2026-10-26.
# alias: token as it appears in compendium Condition/Control text (matched after lower-casing and removing non-alphanumerics;
#        adjacent-token pairs are also tried, e.g. 'Plk1(as)' -> 'plk1as').
# maps_to: name of the same compound in an affinity source (Klaeger/Reinecke/CurveCurator/Davis/Hijazi kinhib) -> affinities from there.
# targets: ';'-separated kinase symbols used when no affinity profile exists (class tokens like 'MEKi', or compounds missing from all
#          sources). Then occupancy = dose/(dose+kd_nM) if kd_nM is given (dose parsed; unknown dose = 1 uM), else the fixed 'occ'.
# kd/occ values for 'targets' rows are literature potencies (approximate, from memory; flagged as ASSUMPTION in docs/features_phospho.md).
